name: Galantamine
mechanism: Reversible acetylcholinesterase inhibitor and nicotinic receptor modulator
dosing: Start 4 mg twice daily, increase to 8 mg twice daily after 4 weeks; max 12 mg twice daily (24 mg/day)
interactions: Anticholinergics (antagonism), beta-blockers (bradycardia), NSAIDs (↑ GI bleed risk)
monitoring: Cognition, weight, GI side effects, heart rate
sideEffects: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, anorexia, bradycardia, insomnia
pharmacokinetics: Oral, hepatic metabolism; adjust in severe hepatic impairment
clinicalPearls: Alternative to donepezil/rivastigmine for mild–moderate Alzheimer’s; consider GI side effects on initiation.
